text:
Ama egwuregwu a maara maka 2026 World Cup dị ka Estadio Guadalajara — ma n’oge ka ukwuu nke ndụ ya dị ka Estadio Akron — e chepụtara ya ka ọ bụrụ ụlọ ọhụrụ maka C.D. Guadalajara, ndị chọrọ ịpụ n’Ama egwuregwu Jalisco nke akụkọ ihe mere eme. A mara ọkwa iwu ya na February 2004, mana igbu oge n’ịkwụ ụgwọ mere ka a ghara ịmalite iwu ya ruo May 2007. E mepere ya na 30 July 2010.

Ụdị ya pụrụ iche. Ọrụ echiche sitere n’aka Jean-Marie Massaud na Daniel Pouzet, ebe Populous, bụbu HOK Sport, mere ihe gbasara iwu ama egwuregwu, VFO bụkwa onye na-edebe ihe. Nsonaazụ ya bụ ụdị okirikiri dị ka coliseum nke e wuru n’ime ugwu ahịhịa kpuchiri kpuchiri azụ nke oche ndị ahụ. Wikipedia kwuru na ego e ji wuo ya na mbụ bụ US$200 million, ọ bụ ezie na ọnụọgụgụ ahụ na-agbagha n’ebe dị iche iche.

A malitere ama egwuregwu ahụ na turf artificial, nke butere nkatọ siri ike site n’aka ndị egwuregwu ma dochie ya na ahịhịa eke n’etiti 2012. Aha ya agbanweela ọtụtụ oge: ọ malitere dị ka Estadio Omnilife site na 2010 ruo 2016, ghọọ Estadio Chivas site na 2016 ruo 2017, ma were aha Estadio Akron site na December 2017 n’okpuru nkwekọrịta ya na ụlọ ọrụ mmanụ Grupo Akron.

Kemgbe e mepere ya na 2010 ọ bụla ụlọ C.D. Guadalajara ma mee egwuregwu ụfọdụ nke otu mba Mexico. Maka 2026 World Cup a gbanwere aha ya nwa oge ka ọ bụrụ Estadio Guadalajara n’okpuru iwu FIFA nke ịdị ọcha nke ama egwuregwu, na-anabata egwuregwu anọ nke otu dị ka naanị ebe 2026 na-enweghị egwuregwu knockout ọ bụla.
